entities.title: MCP over newline-delimited JSON-RPC
entities.summary: One JSON-RPC 2.0 message per line in, one reply per request line out; the server answers initialize, ping, tools/list and tools/call.
consumers: MCP clients that start zazzle-csharp-indexer serve, such as Claude Code (Actors/coding-agent.md)
zazzled (macos/rust/zazzled/), which speaks the same messages on a daemon connection to call the view tool
entities.definition: initialize returns protocolVersion "2024-11-05", capabilities {tools: {}}, serverInfo {name: "zazzle-csharp-indexer", version: ToolVersion.Text} and instructions telling the agent to read, search and edit files through zazzle (zazzle_read, zazzle_find, zazzle_edit) and to use these tools for C# structure (overview, find_symbol, find_references, changed_since, git_log, git_blame), that paths are root:relative/path and that the regex dialect is .NET. tools/list returns each tool's name, description and inputSchema. tools/call {name, arguments} returns {content: [{type: "text", text}], isError}.
guarantees: A message without an id is a notification and gets no reply; blank lines are skipped.
A line that is not JSON gets error -32700 with id null; a request without a method gets -32600; an unknown method gets -32601.
A tool's failure is not a JSON-RPC error: it is a result with isError true and the message as text; an unknown tool name is reported the same way.
Every tools/call, failed or not, writes one usage-log record (src/.dev/observability.json, usage-log).
entities.compatibility: Tool names and argument names are what agents, the instructions, the snippet printed by init and the redirect hook's messages rely on (src/Tools/.dev/operation.json); renaming one breaks existing prompts. zazzled calls the view tool by name.
